nodes.name: Webhook — Receive Confirmation Text
nodes.notes: POST body: { text: '...booking confirmation...', user_id: '...', save_to_supabase: true }

options.systemMessage: You are a travel booking data extraction assistant. Extract structured trip information from booking confirmations. Always return valid JSON only — no markdown, no explanation, no code fences. Be precise with dates (YYYY-MM-DD format). If a field cannot be found, use an empty string.

values.content:
=Extract trip details from the booking confirmation below.

Return ONLY a single valid JSON object with exactly these keys:
{
  "name": "descriptive trip name, e.g. Maui Family Vacation 2026",
  "destination": "city and/or country, e.g. Maui, Hawaii",
  "tripType": "exactly one of: Tropical Resort, Cruise Adventure, Airbnb Getaway, Adventure Trip, City Break, Road Trip, Business Trip, Other",
  "startDate": "YYYY-MM-DD or empty string",
  "endDate": "YYYY-MM-DD or empty string",
  "groupSize": "integer as string or empty string",
  "budget": "total numeric amount only, no $ or commas, e.g. 5240.00, or empty string",
  "participants": "comma-separated full names or empty string",
  "bookingRef": "confirmation/booking/reservation number or empty string",
  "agent": "travel agent name, airline, hotel brand, or booking platform or empty string",
  "notes": "flight numbers, hotel name, room type, special requests, or any other key details"
}

Booking confirmation:
{{ $json.text }}

nodes.name: Save Trip to Supabase
nodes.notes: Uses Supabase anon key — RLS must allow INSERT for authenticated users. For production, swap to service_role key stored in n8n credentials.
